acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Launchable/CloudBees observation mode https://www.launchableinc.com/docs/ , Develocity Predictive Test Selection Simulator https://docs.develocity.ai/predictive-test-selection .

Gap: qualification relies on the frozen fault corpus (AFU-V1-040) and Corvint's own CI shadow selection (V1-0811). There is no operator command to replay a target repository's retained run receipts against e2e-safe or `flows appmap impact`.

Proposal: a read-only report over historical commit pairs. It lists tests the selection would have omitted that actually failed, each with the exclusion proof that omitted it, so proof defects can be located. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: e2e-safe/appmap impact: selection simulator replaying retained receipts to report would-have-missed failures
